name: ProtoGizmon
main_effect:
When you would play this card from your hand, by deleting 1 of your level 2 Digimon from the breeding area, reduce the play cost by 2.
[On Play] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card from your hand.
[All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve.
[On Deletion] By returning 2 cards with [Gizmon] in their names from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order, you may play 1 [Gizmon: AT] from your trash without paying its cost.
